name: Sexiness
short: Random 0–100% sexiness rating for you or a mentioned member.
description: Use [p]sexy or [p]sexy @member for a freshly randomized 0–100% sexiness score, 10-segment meter and playful quip. Alias: [p]sexiness. Just for fun; no data storage, cooldowns or external dependencies.

install_msg: Sexiness installed! Run [p]load sexiness, then [p]sexy or [p]sexy @member.
